data.name: Carbonsmith
data.description: Carbonsmith is a very small startup in Los Angeles, founded around September 2023. It runs a marketplace for carbon dioxide removal credits from engineered removal projects and for renewable energy credits. It acts as a broker or marketplace and does not remove any CO2 itself.
